narrative: Compared to last sale: Bulk of the supply was for future delivery. Supply included 75 percent South Central; 2 percent North Central and 23 percent Southeast. Deliveries are current through November 2026. Current delivery is 14 days from the last day of the video and is up to and including July 9, 2026. Supply included: 99% Feeder Cattle (61% Steers, 32% Heifers, 3% Beef/Dairy Steers, 4% Beef/Dairy Heifers); 1% Replacement Cattle (100% Bred Heifers). Feeder cattle over 600 lbs was 68%. Feeder Cattle prices FOB based on net weights after a 2% pencil shrink or equivalent, with a 0-25 cent slide > 600 lbs and 15-50 cent slide < 600 lbs.
mt_region_label: North Central (CO, IA, MT, ND, NE, SD, WY)
mt_region_note: USDA groups Montana cattle into this multi-state region; figures are regional, not Montana-only.
